facts.en: Completed a retail operations certificate at Fictional Copperkite College in 2022.
facts.zh: 2022 年在虚构铜鸢学院完成零售运营证书课程。

facts.en: Paid parts desk assistant at Fictional Mintwheel Bicycle Workshop from 2023-03 to 2026-08.
facts.zh: 2023-03 至 2026-08 在虚构薄荷轮自行车工坊任有薪零件柜台助理。

facts.en: Matched mechanic-approved part numbers to supplier catalogue entries and current shelf stock.
facts.zh: 将技师批准的零件编号与供应商目录条目及当前货架库存匹配。

facts.en: Recorded customer collection names and order references on labeled parts bags.
facts.zh: 在有标签的零件袋上记录客户取件姓名及订单编号。

facts.en: Checked incoming quantities against supplier delivery notes and recorded shortages.
facts.zh: 按供应商送货单核对到货数量，并记录短缺。

facts.en: Held nonmatching parts in a marked returns tray until the workshop manager confirmed the next action.
facts.zh: 将不匹配零件放入有标记的退货托盘，直至工坊经理确认后续处理。

facts.en: Maintained an order-status sheet with ordered, received, reserved and collected stages.
facts.zh: 维护订单状态表，包含已订购、已收到、已预留及已取走阶段。

facts.en: Notified customers when reserved parts were ready and recorded collection confirmations.
facts.zh: 在预留零件可取时通知客户，并记录取件确认。

facts.en: Uses barcode scanning, spreadsheet lookups and the workshop’s supplier catalogue search.
facts.zh: 使用条码扫描、电子表格查找及工坊供应商目录搜索。

facts.en: Introduced a shelf-location column to the parts sheet in 2024-11 with the workshop manager’s approval.
facts.zh: 2024-11 经工坊经理批准，在零件表中加入货架位置列。

facts.en: Personally labeled 48 storage bins and cross-checked their codes against the parts sheet.
facts.zh: 个人标记 48 个储物格，并将其代码与零件表交叉核对。

facts.en: In a 2025-01 spot check, 29 of 30 sampled reserved orders had both an order-reference label and a recorded shelf location.
facts.zh: 2025-01 抽查中，30 份抽样预留订单有 29 份同时具备订单编号标签及已记录货架位置。

facts.en: Prepared a daily handover list of uncollected reservations, shortages and pending supplier replies.
facts.zh: 每日准备交接清单，列出未取预留件、短缺及待回复供应商事项。

facts.en: Completed an internal parts-catalogue induction in 2023-03.
facts.zh: 2023-03 完成内部零件目录入职培训。

facts.en: Mechanics selected compatibility-critical replacements and carried out repairs; the candidate handled the parts desk.
facts.zh: 技师选择对兼容性有关键要求的替换件并进行维修；候选人负责零件柜台。

facts.en: Volunteered to sort second-hand cycle bells at Fictional Riverbutton Reuse Day in 2021.
facts.zh: 2021 年在虚构河纽再利用日活动中志愿整理二手自行车铃。

facts.en: Made a personal inventory of model-railway components in 2022, separate from workshop records.
facts.zh: 2022 年制作个人模型铁路组件清单，与工坊记录分开。

facts.en: Enjoys assembling small wooden model bridges.
facts.zh: 爱好组装小型木制桥梁模型。
